whatsapp.title: WhatsApp
whatsapp.subtitle: Farm alerts to phones, and entries and questions from staff — through Meta's WhatsApp Cloud API

guide.title: Setup Guide — Step by Step
steps: Open a Meta Developer account at developers.facebook.com → Create App → choose Business → add the WhatsApp product.
On WhatsApp → API Setup, Meta gives you a free test number. Copy its “Phone number ID” below.
In the “To” box on the same page add the numbers that should get alerts (at most 5) and verify each with its OTP — a test number can only message these.

The temporary access token there expires in 24 hours. For a permanent one: business.facebook.com → Business settings → System users → create an Admin system user → assign the app → Generate token with whatsapp_business_messaging and whatsapp_business_management (Expiry: Never).
Paste the token below, switch alerts on and save, then add recipients and press “Test”.

In free mode each recipient sends any message (e.g. “hi”) from their WhatsApp to the business (test) number once a day — every alert in the next 24 hours then arrives free. Send “hi” once before testing too.

(Optional, once on a server) In the app's WhatsApp → Configuration enter the Callback URL and Verify token below and subscribe to the “messages” field. The panel then shows who wrote in and whether messages arrived. This needs a public HTTPS address; localhost will not work.
Keep the Laravel scheduler running on the server (cron: * * * * * php artisan schedule:run) — checks run at 8 AM and 6 PM daily. Sick alerts go out immediately.

connection.title: Connection (Meta Cloud API)
connection.hint: From the Meta app's WhatsApp → API Setup page
connection.token_note: The token is stored encrypted and never shown again. Leave blank to keep the saved one.
connection.secret_note: From App settings → Basic. When set, only webhooks signed by Meta are accepted.

cost.title: Cost Control
cost.free_only_hint: When on, only plain text is sent — Meta never charges for it.
cost.free_tip: Condition: an alert arrives only if the recipient wrote to your business number in the last 24 hours. Otherwise it is not delivered — and nothing is charged.
cost.paid_warning: When off, recipients outside the 24-hour window get the approved template — Meta may charge per message (a payment method is required).
cost.template_hint: Create a Utility template in WhatsApp Manager whose body has one variable, e.g. “Easy Farm alert: {{1}}”. Enter its name here once approved.

webhook.title: Webhook
webhook.hint: Optional — for delivery status and the free window
webhook.regenerate_message: The current token stops working. Paste the new one into the webhook settings in Meta, or delivery updates and replies will stop arriving.
